answer: Flat reputation lets attackers farm identities once and harvest them forever, so decay makes standing perishable. Every identity starts at 100 points and loses 6 per idle epoch; below 60, rewards stop, and honest work restores 5 per epoch. The orchard of old accounts needs constant tending: 20 idle epochs drops a score to zero. Keeping 1,000 clones alive costs 2,000 credits per epoch, while a meadow of decayed identities loses 6,000 points per epoch. Forgery resets the score to 10 and freezes rewards for 8 epochs, so the oasis an attacker hopes for evaporates before use.
